name: E-money covered 100% by unencumbered liquid trust assets (NPS Act 2020 s.60)
description: Regulatory hard limit: eligible trust assets at least 100% of e-money outstanding. The warning at 102% is a placeholder.

name: At most 20% of e-money held at one institution (NPS Regulations 2021 reg 15(2)-(3))
description: Regulatory hard limit per institution; it does not apply while total e-money is at most UGX 500m. The warning at 18% is a placeholder.

name: No trust shortfall (NPS Act 2020 s.47(1)(a); report at once, reg 24)
description: Regulatory hard limit: any e-money not matched by eligible trust assets breaches.
